<Toolbar.Root /> > keyboard navigation > rtl > orientation: horizontal

scenarios.upstreamTest: <Toolbar.Root /> > keyboard navigation > does not wrap focus when loopFocus is false
<Toolbar.Root /> > prop: disabled > disables all toolbar items except links
scenarios.notes: Links opt out of toolbar disabling.

scenarios.upstreamTest: <Toolbar.Root /> > prop: focusableWhenDisabled > toolbar items can be focused when disabled by default
scenarios.notes: Disabled items stay in the roving order because they are focusable (aria-disabled, no disabled attribute).

scenarios.upstreamTest: <Toolbar.Root /> > prop: focusableWhenDisabled > toolbar items can individually disable focusableWhenDisabled
<Toolbar.Root /> > prop: focusableWhenDisabled > moves the initial tab stop off a disabled, non-focusable first item
scenarios.notes: A natively disabled item cannot hold the roving tab stop; looping back skips it.

scenarios.upstreamTest: <Toolbar.Root /> > prop: focusableWhenDisabled > keeps an enabled item with focusableWhenDisabled={false} navigable
<Toolbar.Root /> > prop: focusableWhenDisabled > skips a disabled Toolbar.Input with focusableWhenDisabled={false}
scenarios.notes: Nested disabled input is skipped by roving focus.
